name: pronaflow
description: Intelligent AI-powered project management platform with task execution, scheduling, and collaboration
author: PronaFlow Team

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=frontend && npm install --workspace=electron
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=frontend & npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=electron
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=backend && npm run format --workspace=frontend
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules && find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name '.next' -o -name 'dist' -o -name 'build' | xargs rm -rf
